entities.name: SMF
entities.description: Session Management Function responsible for providing PDU connectivity service to the UE via 5GSM signalling.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that establishes PDU sessions via 3GPP and Non-3GPP access networks.

entities.name: UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to establish a PDU session.

entities.name: PDU session authentication and authorization procedure
entities.description: Procedure for authenticating and authorizing PDU sessions.

entities.name: UE-requested PDU session modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to modify an existing PDU session.

entities.name: Network-requested PDU session modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by network to modify an existing PDU session.

entities.name: UE-requested PDU session release procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to release a PDU session.

entities.name: Network-requested PDU session release procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by network to release a PDU session.

entities.name: AMF
entities.description: Access and Mobility Management Function that transfers session management messages between UE and SMF.

relations.description: SMF performs UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure.
SMF performs PDU session authentication and authorization procedure.
SMF performs UE-requested PDU session modification procedure.
SMF performs network-requested PDU session modification procedure.
SMF performs UE-requested PDU session release procedure.
SMF performs network-requested PDU session release procedure.
Session management messages between UE and SMF are transferred via AMF.
Session management messages between UE and SMF are transferred via AMF.
